description: This file implements the TerminationReasonConfigurationService class that provides business logic to manage termination reasons in the HR management system. It interfaces with the data access object (DAO) to perform CRUD operations and retrieve termination reasons based on various filters.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class providing termination reason management functionalities such as create, retrieve, delete, and checking existence of termination reasons, utilizing DAO for database operations.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao instance.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a TerminationReason entity to the database.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its ID.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TerminationReason by its name.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of termination reasons based on specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Returns the count of termination reasons matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the given name exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of termination reasons that are currently in use.
